data.action: 盘坐在宣纸中央，手持毛笔悬停沉思，墨龙与山峦从纸面逸出
data.camera: dynamic wide angle, swirling ink dragons, traditional calligraphy aura
data.description: 【夕 · 画室】堆满万卷水墨长卷与陈年松烟墨锭的画室内，夕赤足盘坐于铺展的宣纸中央，提笔悬停在半空沉思。她回过头斜睨着走近的你，语气傲娇而慵懒——「吵死了……难得有点作画的灵感全被你的脚步声打乱了。罚你坐在这儿给我研墨三个时辰，不准乱动。」
data.lighting: 泼洒的水墨泛着幽冷青蓝微光与金箔碎屑，如梦似幻的东方奇幻大片感
data.promptProse: Dusk sits cross-legged on the enormous studio rice paper, brush suspended above it as dripping ink gives rise to faint dragons and mountain silhouettes. Ink-grey mascot hoodie, lounge shorts and a messy brush-held bun retain the studio outfit. The wide dynamic view includes stacked scrolls and ink sticks around her horns and tail. Cold blue lantern light illuminates sleeves and paper, casting long dark brush shadows as subtle golden flecks catch near the ink forms.
data.title: 夕 · 泼墨画卷·万千水墨腾空起
